update.releaseNotes:
v5.8.3 - Changelog
New --- - Add a `Minimum Energy to Train` option to the `Training` page that rests instead of training once energy drops below the floor. - Add a `Train Wit Instead of Resting` option to the `Training` page, along with `Wit Maximum Failure Chance` and `Minimum Wit Main Stat Gain Threshold`, so a worthwhile Wit training can be taken in place of a rest.
Adjustments --- - Update game data up to `Copano Rickey 2026-07-15`, including the newly added Dirt races. - Raise the stat target sliders on the `Training` page from a maximum of 1200 to 2000. - Add the `Schedule` row to `Settings` and remove the obsolete File Explorer note.
Fixes --- - Fix the epithet race highlighting and the schedule stats missing from the calendar modal. - Fix the unique skill level shown on the Remote Log Viewer being attached to skills that are not the trainee's own unique skill. - Fix the date being misread when OCR wraps it onto two lines.
